source: Anthropic first-party API list prices, as cached in the claude-api skill (Claude Code 2.1.305, 'Current Models' table and per-model migration notes). Re-check https://www.anthropic.com/pricing before quoting a cost outside this repository.
notes: cache_write_5m and cache_write_1h are the 1.25x and 2x write premiums on base input.
cache_read differs by model: 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, 0.025x on Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1, 0.1x on Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5 and Fable 5 / Mythos 5.
claude-sonnet-5-5 cache_read corrected from 0.20 to 0.10 on 2026-11-04 against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (footnote 2: 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5).
long_context applies per request when the request's prompt (uncached + cache write + cache read) exceeds threshold_prompt_tokens; every input-side rate scales by the same factor as base input.
fast_multiplier applies to requests whose usage.speed is 'fast'.
